compendium.summary: Short-duration extradimensional refuge and resource management.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Use it to regroup, hide equipment or create an escape destination with a climbable entry. Eight Medium-or-smaller creatures fit; plan the rope, entry route and time remaining.
Attacks, spells and other effects cannot cross the portal. To attack outside, leave the space and accept exposure, movement costs and hostile readied actions.
The space lasts one hour, so entry time and the rest schedule matter; do not promise an entire uninterrupted one-hour Short Rest inside it. Contents fall out when the spell ends.
Rope Trick plus Plane Shift is not a guaranteed same-plane teleport. That interpretation is legacy/ruling-sensitive and needs explicit DM agreement.
